sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: A KI master's in public health would give you research skills, a European network and a real credential for epidemiology work. It does nothing for USMLE or ECFMG. If the course runs two years from autumn 2027, it ends in mid-2029, after the Sept 2028 ERAS window for the 2029 Match. Sweden also requires its own licensing route in Swedish, which a master's does not shorten.

ul: **Catch 1: living costs.** Tuition-only means Stockholm rent and food come from your USD 30,000, which the US exam route also needs.
**Catch 2: first-choice rule.** Ranking KI first on universityadmissions.se means you cannot hedge with another university in that slot.
**Catch 3: tiny award pool.** About 10 to 12 awards across all programmes, with academic merit and motivation deciding.
**Catch 4: unverified window.** The scholarship window (8 to 24 Feb 2027 on the board) was not confirmed, because ki.se could not be opened in our check.

p: Treat this as an optional second track, not a plan. Apply only if you can show real living-cost funding and are content to push the US Match later. If you apply, do it for the 15 Jan 2027 programme deadline and confirm the scholarship window on ki.se first.

fixed: Dates: Gemini gave 15 Oct 2025 to 15 Jan 2026 and a Feb 2026 scholarship window; those are the 2026-entry cycle, and the official autumn 2027 programme deadline is 15 Jan 2027 with documents and fee by 1 Feb 2027.
Scholarship window: Gemini said 10 Jan to 28 Feb; the exact KI window could not be confirmed on ki.se.
Eligible programmes: Gemini listed Molecular Techniques in Life Science as eligible; the official notes say that joint programme is excluded, along with Biostatistics and Data Science.
Gemini's SEK 900 application fee matches the University Admissions page.
Removed Gemini's tuition totals and Stockholm monthly living-cost figures, which could not be confirmed.

bcs52.tag: Not open yet, and it pulls against a 2029 US Match
bcs52.lede: The 52nd regular BCS is Bangladesh's civil service recruitment exam, and doctors can enter its health cadre. As of 3 Nov 2026 there is **no circular**, so there is nothing to apply for yet. Press reports say BPSC planned it for November 2026, but that is unconfirmed.

us: Government service and a long selection cycle collide with Step 1, Step 2 CK and a 2029 Match.
eu: Bangladeshi service history carries no weight with European regulators.
interest: A health-cadre post is stable, but it is clinical, not public health research.

ul: A permanent government post if you are selected. Pay and posting are set by the government.
The application fee is not yet fixed. The standing instruction shows **Tk 700** (Tk 100 reduced) for reference only.
Bangladeshi citizens within the age limits and academic rules in the circular, which is not out yet.
Do not confuse this with the **51st BCS (Special)** for doctors: that circular was dated 24 Sep 2026 and applications closed 25 Oct 2026, with its own fee of Tk 205.
Circular: not published as of 3 Nov 2026. Press reports of BPSC's roadmap point to November 2026, unverified.
Check bpsc.gov.bd weekly. Everything else (exam stages, results) follows the circular.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: BCS is a Bangladesh career route, not a licensing step. The exam, results and posting stages take years, and a government post leaves little time for USMLE study or US clinical experience. It makes sense only as a safety net if the 2029 Match plan fails.

ul: **Catch 1: nothing to apply for.** The circular does not exist yet.
**Catch 2: wrong exam risk.** The 51st Special (doctors) is a different, already-closed exam.
**Catch 3: time collision.** A multi-stage selection cycle runs straight through your Step 1 and Step 2 CK window.
**Catch 4: fee unknown.** Do not trust any fee figure until the 52nd circular is out.

p: Keep the US plan as your main track. Watch bpsc.gov.bd, and only prepare for BCS as a deliberate backup. Do not let it eat Step 1 preparation time.

fixed: Application fee: Gemini said BDT 700 and BDT 200 for some categories; the standing BPSC instruction says Tk 700 and Tk 100 for reduced categories, and the 52nd circular will confirm.
Gemini called the 52nd a future cycle with a circular expected late 2026 to early 2027; BPSC's roadmap reported in Sept 2026 says November 2026, and bpsc.gov.bd shows no circular yet.
Gemini said the 47th, 48th (Special) and 49th BCS were in progress; the latest official activity is the 51st BCS (Special), a separate doctors' exam that closed 25 Oct 2026.
Removed Gemini's exam-format details, age limits and salary scale, which were not confirmed against a circular.

fcps.tag: Cheap exam, but the Jan 2027 window closes today and you are not yet eligible
fcps.lede: FCPS Part I is the entry exam for Bangladesh's FCPS postgraduate fellowship, held in January and July. Registration for the **January 2027** session runs 11 Oct to **3 Nov 2026**, which is today, and it needs an up-to-date BM&DC registration certificate, which the board reads as permanent registration that you will not have until the internship ends. The first realistic sitting is the January 2028 session.

us: Syllabus overlaps Step 1, but FCPS training would block the 2029 Match.
interest: FCPS in Community Medicine exists but is a Bangladesh qualification.

ul: **Tk 11,000** for new candidates and **Tk 10,000** for reseat (July 2025 table).
Withdrawal before the deadline refunds the fee less 25%. For the January session the withdrawal deadline is 27 Nov.

An MBBS recognised by BM&DC and an up-to-date **BM&DC registration certificate** uploaded with the application. The board reads this as permanent registration, which is not confirmed in the notice we could check.
You can complete Part I in up to two specialities.
January 2027 session: registration 11 Oct to **3 Nov 2026** (online guide). The BCPS notice is dated 14 Oct 2026.
Admit cards come around late November and the exam starts around 1 Dec 2026, per the board.
We did not check the July session registration dates. Your internship runs to late 2027, so the practical target is January 2028.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: Part I does not count for ECFMG, USMLE or any European regulator. Its value is as a low-cost Bangladesh fallback. The basic-science revision overlaps Step 1, but the exam is its own format. Full FCPS training is a multi-year, full-time commitment that conflicts with the 2029 Match.

ul: **Catch 1: registration rule.** BCPS requires an up-to-date BM&DC registration certificate. The board reads this as permanent registration, so an attempt before the internship ends is likely blocked.
**Catch 2: fee uncertainty.** The board read Tk 6,000 for Jan 2027, the last official table says Tk 11,000.
**Catch 3: training trap.** Passing Part I invites you into years of FCPS training that would crowd out USMLE work.
**Catch 4: new pattern.** A revised Part I question pattern applies from July 2026.

p: Do not chase the January 2027 window. Put Step 1 first, and plan Part I as a cheap backup for the January 2028 session only if the US route needs a fallback.

fixed: Fee: Gemini said BDT 10,000 to 12,000 per attempt; the BCPS fee table shows Tk 11,000 for new candidates and Tk 10,000 for reseat.
Application window: Gemini said it opens Sept to Oct and closes late Oct 2026; BCPS registration for the January session runs 11 Oct to 3 Nov 2026.
Eligibility: Gemini said you can apply in the final months of internship; BCPS requires an up-to-date BM&DC registration certificate at registration (the board reads this as permanent registration).
Removed Gemini's pass-rate and Part II training details, which could not be confirmed on bcps.edu.bd.

mdms.tag: Closed for March 2027, and a multi-year residency clashes with your plan
mdms.lede: Bangladesh Medical University (formerly BSMMU) runs the MD/MS residency, a structured specialist training. Applications for the **March 2027** session have already closed: the admit-card notice came out on 25 Oct 2026. The next intake would be March 2028, announced by a fresh notice.

us: A multi-year full-time residency blocks Step 1, CK and US experience.
eu: Not recognised as a specialist qualification in Europe.
interest: Clinical training, not public health or research.

ul: The fee is not published in the notices we could read.
Pay for residents was not verified in the notices we could read.
The board notes past cycles required a completed internship (not verified), so March 2028 is the earliest realistic intake (likely, not verified).
International applicants cannot apply directly: they go through their embassy and need a completed internship, two years since the degree, home registration accepted by BMDC and be 45 or under.
March 2027 session: application window closed; admit-card notice dated **25 Oct 2026**.
A fresh notice for the next intake will appear on bmu.ac.bd. The board saw a 17 Sep 2026 notice for March 2027.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: The degree does not replace USMLE, ECFMG or any European licensing step. The workload would leave little time for Step 1, Step 2 CK or US clinical experience. Entering in 2028 would run well past the 2029 Match.

ul: **Catch 1: already closed.** The March 2027 window is gone.
**Catch 2: multi-year lock-in.** Full-time training from 2028 competes directly with the 2029 Match.
**Catch 3: fee unknown.** Not confirmed for MD/MS in any notice we could read.
**Catch 4: name change.** BSMMU became Bangladesh Medical University in April 2025; old links still refer to the same institution.

p: Skip this cycle. Do not apply in 2028 unless you have decided to build a Bangladesh career and drop the 2029 Match.

fixed: Timeline: Gemini said the circular comes mid-September, the window runs late Sept to October and the test is in November; BMU's admit-card notice of 25 Oct 2026 shows applications for March 2027 have already closed.
Gemini put an honorarium of about 35,000 BDT a month; this could not be confirmed on bmu.ac.bd.
Gemini said you can apply as a private candidate with no experience; BMU's official page lists a completed internship and, for international candidates, two years since the degree.
Removed Gemini's exam format and phase breakdown, which could not be confirmed on BMU's pages.

gulfother.tag: A paid-job idea, but a sponsor comes first and it is not realistic before 2029
gulfother.lede: Oman, Kuwait and Bahrain each run their own doctor licensing, and every one needs an employer sponsor and a work visa. There is no intake window: licensing is rolling. The board treats this as not realistic before about 2029, and the experience rules it cites come from secondary sources.

us: Paid work could help fund the exam route, but it is not US clinical experience.
eu: Gulf licences do not transfer to Europe.
interest: General practice, not public health or research.

ul: Bahrain: **BD 20** application, **BD 50** exam, then a licence at BD 60, 80 or 100 by grade.
Kuwait: **KD 20** licence issuance for the government sector.
Oman: fee not published on the official pages we could check. Add credential verification and visa costs.
Bahrain: usually invited by a licensed facility through NHRA's Mehan system.
Oman: an Omani employer sponsor is mandatory, plus an OMSB classification exam via Pearson VUE.
Kuwait: employer-driven, with a Ministry of Health interview.
No fixed window in any of the three.
Realistically you would only be eligible after the internship ends in late 2027.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: A Gulf licence is not recognised for US or European practice. A job there could build savings and clinical experience, but it is not US clinical experience, and Gulf contracts can pull you off the 2029 Match timeline. Treat it as a financing option, not a pathway.

ul: **Catch 1: sponsor first.** A licence alone does not give you a job or visa.
**Catch 2: unverified experience rules.** The board's two-to-three-year figures come from secondary sources.
**Catch 3: Oman unknown.** No official fee schedule was found.
**Catch 4: Bahrain fees are old.** The published table dates from a 2016 resolution; confirm in Mehan.

p: Not a priority now. Revisit after the internship if you need a paid year; ask an actual employer what they require before spending on verification.

fixed: Exam fees: Gemini put the Oman and Bahrain exams at about USD 300 each; the official figures are Bahrain BD 20 application plus BD 50 exam, and Kuwait KD 20 issuance. Oman's fee is not published.
Kuwait: Gemini said the exam fee is employer-paid and called Kuwait a dead end; the official page shows a KD 20 issuance fee and a Ministry of Health interview, and hiring is employer-driven.
Gemini's salary ranges for all three countries were not confirmed on any official page and were removed.
Removed Gemini's claim that fresh graduates can sit exams monthly in Dhaka, which could not be confirmed.

euother.tag: The EU rules do not apply to your degree, so every country is its own project
euother.lede: This is the umbrella of country-by-country licensing for doctors in Italy, the Nordics, Poland, Czechia, Hungary and Romania. The EU's automatic recognition covers **EU/EEA qualifications only**. With a Bangladeshi MBBS you are under each country's national rules, with language and exams on top.

us: No link to USMLE; time and money would compete with it.
eu: The real European clinical route, but one language and one country at a time.
interest: Clinical practice, not public health or research.

ul: No EU-level fee. Each country sets its own, and none were verified.
The big costs are language courses, translations and living costs while you qualify.
You apply to the national authority of the country you want.
A non-EU qualification means national rules. Only after one EU country recognises you and you work there **3 years** can you use the EU rules elsewhere.
Italy: the board notes work without recognition (in deroga) was extended to 31 Dec 2027, but that is unverified on an official gazette.
No window: applications are rolling.
EU timelines of 1 month to acknowledge and 3 months to decide apply to EU-qualification holders, not to you.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: This is the direct Europe route, but only through a language you do not yet speak. It competes with the US plan for time and money, so the realistic move is to pick one lane by early 2027 and start the language early.

ul: **Catch 1: no automatic recognition.** Directive 2005/36/EC does not cover a Bangladeshi MBBS.
**Catch 2: language first.** Clinical practice needs the local language, so start well before applying.
**Catch 3: country-by-country.** Fees, exams and timelines differ, so no cost estimate is reliable yet.
**Catch 4: US conflict.** Splitting USD 30,000 and a year of study time across both routes weakens both.

p: Do not start a European licensing route while Step 1 is your priority. If Europe becomes your main goal, choose one country and begin language learning, then check that country's regulator directly.

fixed: EU recognition: Gemini said you apply country by country with no automatic recognition; the official Your Europe page confirms non-EU qualifications fall under national rules.
Gemini gave country cost ranges of EUR 2,000 to 15,000 and per-country exam details; the official EU pages state no fee, and country figures were not verified.
Gemini said recognition takes 6 to 12 months; the EU deadlines (1 month acknowledgement, 3 months decision) apply to EU-qualification holders, not to a Bangladeshi MBBS.
Removed Gemini's salary tables and per-country exam dates, which could not be confirmed on official pages.

akf-isp.tag: Half loan, last resort, and not for the UK or Russia
akf-isp.lede: The Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme funds postgraduate study as **50% grant and 50% loan**, as a resource of last resort. Bangladesh is eligible. The 2026-27 cycle is closed; the next opens in early 2027, with no closing date published yet.

us: A half loan would be hard to carry alongside a USD 30,000 exam budget.
eu: Works for study in many countries, but not the UK.
interest: Master's in public health or epidemiology fits.

ul: A mix of **50% grant and 50% loan**. The loan carries a service charge and starts repaying six months after you finish or withdraw.
A guarantor must co-sign the loan.
Master's applicants are prioritised; PhD funding covers only the first two years.
Bangladesh is an eligible country. Preference goes to applicants under 30.
You must show real financial need and a multi-source funding plan, and already be admitted to a reputable postgraduate institution, starting year one.
Not available for study in the **United Kingdom or Russia**.
2026-27 cycle: closed.
Next cycle: opens early 2027. No closing date is published yet.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: A funded MPH could add a research record and a network, but it does not replace Step 1, Step 2 CK or ECFMG certification. Because half the award is a loan, a US master's would still cost far more than your budget, and the UK is excluded.

ul: **Catch 1: loan half.** 50% must be repaid with a service charge, and a guarantor signs.
**Catch 2: admission first.** You need an offer before the award, so tuition deposits and application fees come first.
**Catch 3: UK excluded.** Imperial, LSHTM and Edinburgh are not eligible.
**Catch 4: limited awards.** A small number per cycle, with need and a multi-source plan required.

p: Low priority. Watch the AKDN page in early 2027, but only apply if you already have a place somewhere outside the UK and a clear way to carry the loan.

fixed: Study destinations: Gemini suggested Imperial, Oxford, LSHTM and Edinburgh; the official page says the programme is not available for study in the United Kingdom or Russia.
Admission status: Gemini said an active application is enough; the official page says you must already be admitted and starting year one.
Gemini put the loan service charge at 5% a year and said it must be repaid within 5 years; the official page states a service charge and repayment six months after graduation but no rate was seen.

Application route: Gemini said applications run Jan to March with a Geneva final decision; the official page states only that the next cycle opens in early 2027 and applications go through local AKF contacts.
Removed Gemini's claim of 3 to 5 awards for Bangladesh, which could not be confirmed.

nz.tag: Not open to you this cycle: you need USMLE or PLAB 1 first
nz.lede: NZREX is New Zealand's clinical registration exam for doctors who qualify through a prerequisite exam. You need a pass in **PLAB Part 1, MCCQE Part I, AMC MCQ or USMLE Steps 1 and 2 CK** within the last 5 years, so you cannot sit the 2027 sittings. It is only a backup once your USMLE steps are done.

us: Your USMLE passes double as the NZREX prerequisite.

ul: **NZD 860.92** application plus **NZD 4,966.94** exam fee, both with GST.
Add flights to Auckland, accommodation, English tests and ECFMG's EPIC verification.
An acceptable primary medical qualification and English-language requirements met.
A pass within the last **5 years** in one prerequisite exam.
Your degree and exam results must be primary-source verified through ECFMG's EPIC (MyIntealth) before you apply.
Sittings: **6 Mar 2027** and **4 Sep 2027** in Auckland.
No closing date; applications are taken in order and fill well before any date.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: If you pass Step 1 and Step 2 CK for the Match, NZREX stays open as a five-year backup. It has no European recognition and no research angle. Passing does not give registration: you still need a first-year training job in New Zealand.

ul: **Catch 1: prerequisite gap.** You have no qualifying exam yet.
**Catch 2: job not guaranteed.** Passing NZREX does not guarantee a PGY1 post; the pass rate averages 66%.
**Catch 3: cost.** Fees alone are about NZD 5,800 before travel.
**Catch 4: five-year clocks.** Both the prerequisite and the NZREX pass expire after 5 years.

p: Do not spend on this now. Keep it in mind as a fallback once Step 1 and Step 2 CK are passed, and revisit the fee list then.

fixed: Exam fee: Gemini said NZD 4,500 to 5,500; MCNZ's list shows NZD 4,966.94 for the exam plus a NZD 860.92 application fee, both including GST.
English requirement: Gemini gave IELTS 7.5, OET B and PTE 65 scores; these were not confirmed in what we could read.
Gemini's 66% pass rate, 5-year validity and 6 Mar and 4 Sep 2027 dates match the official page.
Removed Gemini's 16-station OSCE description and its claim that MCNZ recommends a year of home-country experience, which could not be confirmed.

mymph.tag: Affordable and open to MBBS graduates, but a modest career payoff
mymph.lede: A self-funded MPH at a Malaysian university such as Universiti Malaya is a cheap way to get a public health master's. UM's MPH fees for non-citizens are **MYR 31,100** (Oct 2025). It is a coursework programme open to medical graduates, but it does not help the licensing side of your plan.

us: Cheap, but a year in Malaysia would sit between internship and the Match.
eu: A master's degree, not a licence; recognition varies.
interest: Direct match for public health and epidemiology.

ul: UM application fee: **RM300** for international applicants.
UM MPH tuition: **MYR 31,100** for non-citizens (department table, Oct 2025). That is tuition, not an application fee.
Add living costs, which were not checked.
UM's MPH is open to medical and health-science graduates.
UM notes English at IELTS band 6.0 in listings.
Each other university sets its own rules.
UM has two intakes: Semester I (Sept/Oct) and Semester II (Feb/March).
The 2027 UM MPH deadline was not found on official pages. Check each university directly.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: An MPH can add a research project and a degree to a Match application, but US programmes weigh Step scores and US clinical experience far more. Check start dates against your internship, which runs to late 2027.

ul: **Catch 1: no deadline.** The 2027 UM MPH date is not published where we looked.
**Catch 2: umbrella.** UM's fee is not a Malaysia-wide fee.
**Catch 3: internship overlap.** A Sept 2027 start clashes with your internship.
**Catch 4: limited payoff.** It does not replace USMLE steps or US clinical experience.

p: A reasonable low-cost backup if you decide on a public health master's. Do not apply until you have confirmed dates, tuition and a start that fits after the internship.

fixed: Tuition: Gemini said UM international tuition is about RM 35,000 to 45,000; UM's department table shows MYR 31,100 for non-citizens.
Application fee: Gemini gave none; UM's admission FAQ lists RM300 for international applicants (RM50 for Malaysians).
Deadlines: Gemini said Sept 2027 applications run Jan to May 2027 and a Feb intake closes in Nov 2026; UM states only its two intakes and no 2027 deadline was found.
Removed Gemini's per-university tuition ranges and CGPA thresholds, which could not be confirmed.

msf.tag: Real jobs, but not open to a new graduate
msf.lede: MSF, IRC and ICRC hire doctors for field and country posts. These are jobs, not scholarships, and recruitment is rolling. Field posts need a professional qualification, availability and typically relevant experience, which you will not have until you have worked a few years.

us: Hard to fit around a 2029 Match, and it is not US clinical experience.
eu: Humanitarian work is valued but gives no European licence.
interest: Strong fit for global health and epidemiology.

ul: No application fee. MSF states it **never asks for money**.
Pay and benefits are set per organisation and post; salary figures were not verified.
Each vacancy sets its own requirements, typically a licence plus relevant experience.
The board notes 2 or more years after the internship, but that figure is not an official ruling.
MSF routes applicants through the office for their country of residence.
No intake: rolling, with each post closing separately.
MSF field-pool selection typically takes 3 to 6 months from web registration.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: This is a strong global health story for later, not a way to qualify. It does not replace USMLE or European licensing, and a field posting would interrupt exam preparation. Revisit after you have clinical experience.

ul: **Catch 1: experience gate.** You are not ready for a field post yet.
**Catch 2: scams.** Anyone asking for payment to apply is not MSF, IRC or ICRC.
**Catch 3: timing.** A posting would fall in your Step 1 and Step 2 CK window.
**Catch 4: risk.** Field posts can involve insecure settings.

p: Park this. Build clinical experience and the exam record first, then apply to specific posts that fit. If you want a humanitarian taste sooner, check what national-staff posts exist in Bangladesh.

fixed: Experience: Gemini said MSF requires a strict 2 years post-internship and ICRC 3 or more years; the official pages state essential requirements per profile, typically relevant experience, with no fixed figure found.
Pay: Gemini quoted EUR 1,800 to 2,500 (MSF), USD 3,000 to 6,000 (IRC) and CHF 4,500 to 6,500 (ICRC); none could be confirmed on official pages.
Gemini's no-fee warning matches MSF's official statement that it never asks for financial participation.
Gemini said MSF applicants use MSF South Asia or India; MSF's official page says applications go to the office responsible for your country of residence.
Removed Gemini's IRC Bangladesh national-staff claims, which could not be confirmed.

cra.tag: Paid abroad work exists, but CRA roles usually want prior experience
cra.lede: CRA (clinical research associate), pharmacovigilance and health-data jobs are non-clinical industry roles. They are applied for job by job, with no fee or window. CRA roles typically want prior clinical research or monitoring experience, while entry-level pharmacovigilance and data roles exist but vary.

us: Paid and non-clinical, but time away from US clinical experience.
eu: Employer-sponsored visas are possible but vary by company.
interest: Clinical research and pharmacovigilance fit your interests.

ul: No application fee anywhere.
Pay was not verified on official sources.
Eligibility is per employer and per country: visa rules, GCP knowledge, and for CRA roles usually prior experience.
Visa sponsorship is employer-specific and must be read on each posting.
No window. Each vacancy closes on its own or when filled.
You are not realistic for most roles until the internship ends in late 2027.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: These jobs do not give a licence and are not US clinical experience, so they do not move the 2029 Match. They can give income and research skills, and some roles are remote. Treat them as a paid backup rather than a plan.

ul: **Catch 1: experience gate.** CRA posts typically want monitoring or research experience.
**Catch 2: visa.** Sponsorship depends on the employer and country.
**Catch 3: time away from medicine.** Long gaps from clinical work can hurt a later Match application.
**Catch 4: scams.** Never pay to apply or be registered.

p: Low priority now. If you want income later, target entry-level pharmacovigilance or data roles and read each posting's visa rule. Do not let it replace Step 1 preparation.

fixed: Entry level: Gemini said fresh MBBS graduates with GCP certificates are widely hired as CRAs; the employer postings checked say CRA roles typically need prior clinical research or monitoring experience.
Gemini named IQVIA, Parexel, Syneos and PPD graduate programmes and quoted salaries; none could be confirmed on official pages.
Visas: Gemini said many European firms sponsor visas readily; sponsorship is employer-specific and must be checked per posting.
Gemini's no-fee statement matches the official position that legitimate employers never charge candidates to apply.

gsu-mph.tag: 15 Feb 2027 priority deadline; funding is a long shot
gsu-mph.lede: Georgia State's MPH runs through SOPHAS plus a GSU supplemental form. For Fall 2027, the key date is **15 Feb 2027** for scholarship consideration and international applicants. Funding is a limited graduate research assistantship that pays a **stipend and a tuition waiver** for up to 20 hours a week and is explicitly **not guaranteed**.

us: US presence helps, but F-1 and tuition strain a USD 30,000 plan.
eu: A US master's is recognised, but it is not a licence.
interest: Epidemiology and global health in Atlanta fit your interests.

ul: **$155** SOPHAS plus **$50** GSU supplemental, so about **$205** to apply.
2026-27 out-of-country graduate tuition is **$34,302** plus **$1,320** fees; the cost of attendance is **$59,666.51** on campus or **$62,376.08** off campus (a 42-credit, about two-year degree).
The international office's I-20 funding sheet shows **$49,622** to document (2025-26 rates, 18 credits a year).
Incoming MPH scholarships start from **$2,500**; the assistantship **stipend amount is not stated**.
MBBS holders can apply; foreign credentials need a WES evaluation.
No GRE required for the MPH.
The notes say a degree is needed 'at the time of enrolment'; that catalog page could not be re-checked.
International applicants should use the 15 Feb priority deadline.
Fall 2027: **15 Feb 2027** priority (scholarship consideration and international applicants), 15 Jun regular.
Spring: 1 Oct priority, 1 Nov regular.

sections.h: How it fits the US and Europe goals
p: Atlanta would give you US letters and a US base, but an MPH does not replace Step scores or US clinical experience. A degree starting Fall 2027 would clash with the internship and the Sept 2028 ERAS window.

ul: **Catch 1: funding not guaranteed.** Graduate research assistantships are funded by faculty grants, are limited, and carry no stated amount.
**Catch 2: cost.** Without funding, the $49,622-$62,376 yearly figure is heavy against USD 30,000.
**Catch 3: timing.** Fall 2027 overlaps your internship.
**Catch 4: WES.** Credential evaluation takes time and money.

p: Apply only if you can fund the whole degree or land an assistantship, and treat 15 Feb 2027 as your only realistic date. Otherwise save the application fees for Step 1.

fixed: Fees: Gemini gave none; the official figures are SOPHAS $155 plus the GSU supplemental $50.
Tuition: Gemini said $38,000 to 44,000 in-person; GSU's 2026-27 page shows $34,302 tuition plus $1,320 fees for out-of-country students, total $59,666.51 on campus.

Assistantships: Gemini said an assistantship reduces tuition to about $37.50 a semester; GSU's page says positions fund stipends and tuition waivers for up to 20 hours a week, are not guaranteed, and the stipend amount is not stated.
I-20 funding: Confirmed on the official page: $49,622 on the 2025-26 basis.
Gemini's 15 Feb, 15 Jun, 1 Oct and 1 Nov deadlines match GSU's page.
Degree timing: The notes said a degree is required at the time of enrolment; the catalog page could not be fetched, so it is not confirmed.
gsu-mph.ai_note: Drafted from your uploaded notes, then checked against the official pages on 9 Nov 2026. Where they disagreed, the official page won.

glasgow-great.tag: £10,000 off tuition, but you need a place with conditions met by 30 Apr 2027
